title: A comfortable weekend at the hotel

sentences.text_target: Tom arrived at the grand hotel after a long taxi ride.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm əˈraɪvd ət ðə ɡrænd həʊˈtɛl ˈɑːftər ə lɒŋ ˈtæksi raɪd/
sentences.text_native: Tom est arrivé au grand hôtel après un long trajet en taxi.

sentences.text_target: He walked inside and waited in a short queue.
sentences.phonetic: /hi wɔːkt ɪnˈsaɪd ənd ˈweɪtɪd ɪn ə ʃɔːt kjuː/
sentences.text_native: Il est entré et a attendu dans une courte file d'attente.

sentences.text_target: The receptionist smiled and greeted him politely.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈsɛpʃənɪst smaɪld ənd ˈɡriːtɪd hɪm pəˈlaɪtli/
sentences.text_native: La réceptionniste a souri et l'a salué poliment.

sentences.text_target: Tom showed his passport and confirmed his online reservation.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm ʃəʊd ɪz ˈpɑːspɔːt ənd kənˈfɜːmd ɪz ˈɒnlaɪn ˌrɛzəˈveɪʃən/
sentences.text_native: Tom a montré son passeport et a confirmé sa réservation en ligne.

sentences.text_target: He signed the form with a small plastic pen.
sentences.phonetic: /hi saɪnd ðə fɔːm wɪð ə smɔːl ˈplæstɪk pɛn/
sentences.text_native: Il a signé le formulaire avec un petit stylo en plastique.

sentences.text_target: Then he paid the bill using his credit card.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɛn hi peɪd ðə bɪl ˈjuːzɪŋ ɪz ˈkrɛdɪt kɑːd/
sentences.text_native: Ensuite, il a payé l'addition en utilisant sa carte de crédit.

sentences.text_target: The helpful staff member gave him a shiny key card.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈhɛlpfʊl stɑːf ˈmɛmbə ɡeɪv hɪm ə ˈʃaɪni kiː kɑːd/
sentences.text_native: Le membre du personnel serviable lui a remis une carte-clé brillante.

sentences.text_target: Tom took his heavy luggage and walked to the lift.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm tʊk ɪz ˈhɛvi ˈlʌɡɪdʒ ənd wɔːkt tuː ðə lɪft/
sentences.text_native: Tom a pris ses lourds bagages et s'est dirigé vers l'ascenseur.

sentences.text_target: A friendly porter offered to carry his bags.
sentences.phonetic: /ə ˈfrɛndli ˈpɔːtər ˈɒfəd tuː ˈkæri ɪz bæɡz/
sentences.text_native: Un porteur sympathique a proposé de porter ses sacs.

sentences.text_target: They rode the elevator up to the fourth floor.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeɪ rəʊd ðə ˈɛlɪvətər ʌp tuː ðə fɔːθ flɔː/
sentences.text_native: Ils ont pris l'ascenseur jusqu'au quatrième étage.

sentences.text_target: They walked down a quiet corridor to room number forty-two.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeɪ wɔːkt daʊn ə ˈkwaɪət ˈkɒrɪdɔː tuː ruːm ˈnʌmbə ˈfɔːti-tuː/
sentences.text_native: Ils ont arpenté un couloir calme jusqu'à la chambre numéro quarante-deux.

sentences.text_target: Tom opened the door and stepped inside a comfortable suite.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm ˈəʊpənd ðə dɔːr ənd stɛpt ɪnˈsaɪd ə ˈkʌmfətəbl swiːt/
sentences.text_native: Tom a ouvert la porte et est entré dans une suite confortable.

sentences.text_target: The room had a large bed and a nice balcony.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ruːm hæd ə lɑːdʒ bɛd ənd ə naɪs ˈbælkəni/
sentences.text_native: La chambre disposait d'un grand lit et d'un joli balcon.

sentences.text_target: He opened the glass door and looked at the blue sea view.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈəʊpənd ðə ɡlɑːs dɔːr ənd lʊkt ət ðə bluː siː vjuː/
sentences.text_native: Il a ouvert la porte vitrée et a contemplé la vue sur la mer bleue.

sentences.text_target: After the journey, he felt very tired.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɑːftər ðə ˈdʒɜːni, hi fɛlt ˈvɛri ˈtaɪəd/
sentences.text_native: Après le voyage, il se sentait très fatigué.

sentences.text_target: He took a hot shower in the modern bathroom.
sentences.phonetic: /hi tʊk ə hɒt ˈʃaʊər ɪn ðə ˈmɒdən ˈbɑːθruːm/
sentences.text_native: Il a pris une douche chaude dans la salle de bains moderne.

sentences.text_target: Clean white towels were waiting on the shelf.
sentences.phonetic: /kliːn waɪt ˈtaʊəlz wɜː ˈweɪtɪŋ ɒn ðə ʃɛlf/
sentences.text_native: Des serviettes blanches et propres l'attendaient sur l'étagère.

sentences.text_target: He slept deeply for several hours on the soft mattress.
sentences.phonetic: /hi slɛpt ˈdiːpli fɔː ˈsɛvrəl ˈaʊəz ɒn ðə sɒft ˈmætrɪs/
sentences.text_native: Il a dormi profondément pendant plusieurs heures sur le matelas moelleux.

sentences.text_target: The next morning, the bright sun woke him up early.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə nɛkst ˈmɔːnɪŋ, ðə braɪt sʌn wəʊk hɪm ʌp ˈɜːli/
sentences.text_native: Le lendemain matin, le soleil éclatant l'a réveillé tôt.

sentences.text_target: He wanted to enjoy a good breakfast downstairs.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈwɒntɪd tuː ɪnˈdʒɔɪ ə ɡʊd ˈbrɛkfəst ˌdaʊnˈstɛəz/
sentences.text_native: Il voulait profiter d'un bon petit-déjeuner au rez-de-chaussée.

sentences.text_target: The hotel restaurant offered a large morning buffet.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə həʊˈtɛl ˈrɛstrɒnt ˈɒfəd ə lɑːdʒ ˈmɔːnɪŋ ˈbʊfeɪ/
sentences.text_native: Le restaurant de l'hôtel proposait un grand buffet pour le petit-déjeuner.

sentences.text_target: A polite waiter handed him the daily food menu.
sentences.phonetic: /ə pəˈlaɪt ˈweɪtə ˈhændɪd hɪm ðə ˈdeɪli fuːd ˈmɛnjuː/
sentences.text_native: Un serveur poli lui a tendu la carte du jour.

sentences.text_target: Tom ordered hot coffee and a glass of fresh orange juice.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm ˈɔːdɪd hɒt ˈkɒfi ənd ə ɡlɑːs əv frɛʃ ˈɒrɪndʒ dʒuːs/
sentences.text_native: Tom a commandé du café chaud et un verre de jus d'orange frais.

sentences.text_target: He ate crispy bread with butter and tasty cheese.
sentences.phonetic: /hi eɪt ˈkrɪspi brɛd wɪð ˈbʌtər ənd ˈteɪsti tʃiːz/
sentences.text_native: Il a mangé du pain croustillant avec du beurre et du fromage savoureux.

sentences.text_target: After eating, he walked outside into the warm garden.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈɑːftər ˈiːtɪŋ, hi wɔːkt ˈaʊtsaɪd ˈɪntuː ðə wɔːm ˈɡɑːdn/
sentences.text_native: Après avoir mangé, il est sorti dans le jardin baigné de chaleur.

sentences.text_target: There was a big outdoor pool with clear blue water.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɛə wʌz ə bɪɡ ˈaʊtdɔː puːl wɪð klɪə bluː ˈwɔːtə/
sentences.text_native: Il y avait une grande piscine extérieure avec de l'eau bleue limpide.

sentences.text_target: Many guests were swimming and having fun.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈmɛni ɡɛsts wɜː ˈswɪmɪŋ ənd ˈhævɪŋ fʌn/
sentences.text_native: De nombreux clients nageaient et s'amusaient.

sentences.text_target: Tom decided to relax on a comfortable sunbed.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm dɪˈsaɪdɪd tuː rɪˈlæks ɒn ə ˈkʌmfətəbl ˈsʌnbɛd/
sentences.text_native: Tom a décidé de se détendre sur un transat confortable.

sentences.text_target: He read his favourite book for the entire afternoon.
sentences.phonetic: /hi rɛd ɪz ˈfeɪvərɪt bʊk fɔː ðə ɪnˈtaɪər ˈɑːftənuːn/
sentences.text_native: Il a lu son livre préféré pendant tout l'après-midi.

sentences.text_target: This weekend stay was truly relaxing and pleasant.
sentences.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈwiːkɛnd steɪ wʌz ˈtruːli rɪˈlæksɪŋ ənd ˈplɛzənt/
sentences.text_native: Ce séjour de week-end a été vraiment relaxant et agréable.
